integrity: The universal result is proved by Artin–Schreier polynomial reduction and base-map enumeration. Finite-field exact calculations independently corroborate but do not substitute for the proof. Historical priority not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Classifies unlabelled \((\mathbb Z/2)^2\)-Galois covers with their map to \(\mathbb P^1\) and base automorphisms, not abstract curves or the full curve automorphism group; algebraically closed characteristic two, no finite-field descent assertion. Previously computed genus, \(a\)-number and Ekedahl–Oort types are not new.
title: Fifth-power moduli and automorphism jumps for genus-six Artin–Schreier fibre products
